body.name: localized multiplier-projection interval handle
body.construction: This is only a proposed blueprint, not an established interval.  First derive an estimable first-order process for the actual generated fixed-cardinality prefix path, including both the external empirical-quantile boundary contribution and the fitted-ranking-score derivative.  If that derivation supplies uniformly valid resampling summands, jointly multiplier-resample them, construct a simultaneous region for the local bias contrasts and covariance coordinates, retain every prefix that can minimize the corrected quadratic criterion for some point in that region, and invert worst-case selected-coordinate quantiles over the retained set.  Call the resulting interval \(\mathcal I_n(\alpha)\) only after these operations have been specified.  The present core supplies neither the corrected resampling summands nor their critical values; therefore this handle currently has no established computability, coverage, length, or oracle-adaptation guarantee.
